verdict.rationale: CodeRabbit documents a Learnings knowledge base that stores review preferences taught through chat and applies them automatically to future reviews. It also says it learns from team feedback, persists learnings as retained data, and picks up team convention files such as CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md as review criteria. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that learnings persist and are applied reliably, and documentation of learning automatically from past review decisions (resolved or dismissed comments) beyond explicit chat teaching.
